Dress code

Beach casual, elevated

Dressed up enough for a celebration, comfortable enough to dance. Think a posh cliffside cocktail party in warm weather: lightweight fabrics and breezy silhouettes.

Need a bit of inspiration?

Our recommended colour theme

Soft earthy neutrals or colours from the garden. Pick any of these and you will fit right in.

  • Champagne
  • Sand
  • Beige
  • Grey
  • Pastel
  • Sage
  • Garden green
←→

Where to stay

Bali's traffic is on another level. Stay south of the airport around Pecatu: close to the venue, and you won't spend your trip stuck between Seminyak and Canggu.

Our top pick, we're staying here

Swiss-Belresort Pecatu

We'll run shuttle buses between this hotel and the venue on the day. Tick the hotel and shuttle questions in your RSVP so we can plan seats.

20 minto the venue
50 minto Seminyak
1 hr 40to Canggu
Book a room
Mayiki Boutique HotelBoutique hotel, about 7 minutes' drive from the venue.
Villa Senja EmasCute villa, about 10 minutes' drive from the venue.
Villa Kanu, PecatuOne-bedroom villa, about 10 minutes' drive. Rooms for the wedding dates aren't open yet.

13 min drive

Kutuh & Pandawa Beach

The closest stays, some within walking distance. Cliff-top villas and sunrise at Pandawa Beach. Great for couples.

15 min drive

Ungasan & GWK

Bigger villas for families and groups, near the Garuda Wisnu Kencana cultural park.

22 min drive

Jimbaran

Closest to the airport, for early or late flights. Seafood dinners on the beach at sunset.

25 min drive

Nusa Dua & Benoa

Full-service resorts and calm beaches. Ideal if you're making a longer holiday of it.

Getting there

DPS

Fly into Ngurah Rai, Denpasar International Airport.

1 hr

From the airport to the venue. Check travel times before you set off.

1.5 hrs

From Seminyak or Canggu to the venue, if you're staying up north.

Download Grab before you land and ride from the airport. Please don't drive yourself: a Hong Kong international driving licence doesn't cover Indonesia, and the roads here are an adventure.

Where we love to eat

  • Crumb & CoasterKuta. Our favourite brunch, we went two days in a row.
  • Warung Babi Guling Pak MalenKuta. Iconic Balinese suckling pig, rich with spices.
  • RevolverCanggu, Seminyak. Coffee and brunch.
  • KYNDSeminyak, Canggu, Uluwatu. Plant-based brunch.
  • NookKuta. Local cafe with a good nasi campur.
  • La BaraccaCanggu, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Ubud. Decent Italian.
  • SisterfieldsKuta. Brunch.
  • ArtisanUluwatu. Brunch.
  • House of YorehCanggu. Coffee.
  • Coffee CartelSeminyak, Kuta. Coffee.

Beach clubs & bars

  • FINNS Beach ClubA classic, and our favourite.
  • Potato Head Beach ClubThe original classic.
  • Atlas Beach ClubAnother famous one.
  • Savaya BaliClifftop and very nice.
  • Rock BarGood drinks, good mood, good waves.

Questions, answered

For everything else, call Cher or Gatha. On the day our bridesmaids and groomsmen will be holding our phones.

When is the RSVP deadline?

Please reply by 31 December 2026 so we have an accurate headcount.

Can I bring a date?

Check your invitation for your plus-one, or ask either of us.

Are kids welcome?

As much as we love your little ones, they won't be part of the ceremony or reception. We know some of you are travelling with kids, so we've arranged private rooms where they can relax during the wedding.

What will the weather be like?

August is dry season in Bali, so expect heat and sun. Bring sunscreen and sunglasses, and stay hydrated.

Is the wedding indoors or outdoors?

Everything is outdoors, right in front of our villa. Feel free to head inside for the aircon.

Is there a theme?

Yes: a cliffside party. Think refined, posh cocktail party. See the dress code above.

Can we take photos?

Yes please. We'd love you to capture as many memories as you can.

What time should I arrive?

3:30 pm, for refreshments before the 4:30 pm ceremony.

Where should I park?

There's parking near the entrance.

Will you join us?

Kindly reply by 31 December 2026

Thank you
